title: Career roadmap · Corporate Law Scholar
summary: Build from corporate, competition and securities-law research into rigorous doctrinal and empirical scholarship, regulatory analysis, comparative corporate governance and academic leadership.

facts.Timeline assumption: The roadmap assumes a 2026-start Ph.D. pathway. The early years develop doctrinal research, corporate-governance and empirical methods; later years focus on original scholarship, regulatory engagement, teaching, interdisciplinary research and academic leadership.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Establish deep expertise in company law, securities regulation, competition law, corporate governance and legal research methods.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Develop a recognizable research agenda in corporate governance, capital markets, competition, insolvency, M&A or securities regulation.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Lead research projects, comparative-law programs, regulatory studies, academic collaborations and policy research.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Shape corporate-law scholarship around digital markets, AI, sustainability, platform governance, financial innovation and evolving capital-market regulation.

Career progression

blocks.text: Ph.D. routes

A senior Corporate Law Scholar should combine doctrinal authority with empirical and interdisciplinary research. Keep current with digital markets, AI-driven corporate decision-making, institutional investors, sustainability disclosures, cross-border capital flows, competition in technology markets and financial innovation. Academic influence should increasingly come through sustained research programs, international collaboration, teaching, regulatory engagement and high-quality law reform analysis.
